Native-safe browser-only behaviour (contract rules 4,5,7): (a) usePageTitle feature-detects document.title and no-ops on bare native instead of throwing. (b) fmtNumber try/catches Intl and falls back to toFixed when the host runtime lacks Intl. (c) The web responsive CSS grids (md:grid-cols-3 / md:grid-cols-2) collapse to their mobile-first single-column form (vertical gapped stacks) — every card/stat still renders; this is a deliberate, explicit layout reduction, not missing content.

No DOM-only modules, HTML elements, react-i18next, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, or web UI components are imported — only react, react-native primitives (Animated/Platform/ScrollView/StyleSheet/View/TextStyle/ViewStyle), the ported web-parity client (isApiError) + useSchemaDrift hook, the ported native StatCard, and existing apps/native SemanticIcon/AppText/GlassPanel/theme tokens.
